title: Remove only intended packages and explain retained files
goal: Distinguish rpm erase, dependency order and config retention from Debian remove/purge.
challenge: Starting from the declared pair with header=owner-kept and notes.txt=owner-notes, retain the exact dependent-removal refusal. Remove only report then data, preserve and explain .rpmsave, keep original/edit/notes byte-identical and return to fixture-free package state. RPM has no universal purge equivalent.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/rpm-remove.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && umask 077; here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/rpm-remove.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700; }; fresh() { here || return 19; test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test ! -e "$1" && test ! -L "$1"; }; cfg() { case "$1" in /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf|/etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmnew|/etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmsave) ;; *) return 19;; esac; here && test "$(realpath -e /etc/learning-lab-rpm)" = /etc/learning-lab-rpm && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a /etc/learning-lab-rpm)" = root:root:755 && test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1" && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a:%h "$1")" = root:root:644:1; }; keepcfg() { cfg "$1" && fresh "$w/$2" && cp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && cmp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$w/$2")" = learner:600:1; }; releasecfg() { cfg "$1" && test "${2##*/}" = "$2" && test -f "$w/$2" && test ! -L "$w/$2" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$w/$2")" = learner:600:1 && cmp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && sudo rm -- "$1"; }; h=/usr/local/sbin/ll-rpm-fixture; f=/opt/learning-lab/rpm-fixtures; here && test "$(df -B1 --output=avail / | tail -1)" -ge 1073741824 && fresh "$w/before.json" && sudo "$h" status > before.json && grep -F '"fixtures": {}' before.json && fresh "$w/before-raw.tsv" && timeout -k 1s 20s sudo rpm -qa --qf '%{NAME}\t%{EPOCHNUM}\t%{VERSION}\t%{RELEASE}\t%{ARCH}\n' > before-raw.tsv && fresh "$w/before.tsv" && LC_ALL=C sort before-raw.tsv > before.tsv && pwd
steps.explanation: Record this private path and shell definitions. A guard failure stops the exercise; do not continue over existing fixtures. Resume requires recorded path/definitions, not replaying setup.
steps.expected: Fixture-free package baseline retained without masking query failure.

steps.command: here && sudo "$h" apply pair && keepcfg /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf original.conf && cfg /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf && printf "%s\n" header=owner-kept | sudo tee /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf >/dev/null && keepcfg /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf edited.conf && fresh "$w/notes.txt" && printf "%s\n" owner-notes > notes.txt
steps.explanation: Prepare only declared fixtures; retain original/edit and unrelated user notes.
steps.expected: Exact pair and protected user data.

steps.command: rpm_step() { here || return 19; fresh "$w/dependency.txt" || return 19; if sudo "$h" preview remove-data > dependency.txt 2>&1; then return 1; else test $? = 1 && grep -F "Remove report first" dependency.txt; fi; }; rpm_step
steps.explanation: Do not implicitly remove a dependent package. Require the specific refusal, not any error.

steps.command: here && sudo "$h" apply remove-report && sudo "$h" apply remove-data && cfg /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmsave && cmp edited.conf /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmsave && keepcfg /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmsave retained.conf && test "$(cat notes.txt)" = owner-notes
steps.explanation: Confirm each exact removal. RPM has no universal Debian-style purge; this changed config survives as .rpmsave.
steps.expected: No fixture package rows; owner edit and notes survive.

hints: No universal RPM purge; --nodeps and autoremove can harm unrelated state; absence of rpm row does not mean every user file vanished.
Read supported helper operations and the exact plan before APPLY. Unsigned fixture digests do not prove publisher authenticity.
Verify versions, payload/config bytes and actual learner access; package exit status alone is insufficient.
review: I retained the requested actual output, statuses, versions and byte/access evidence, including the incorrect case.
I met the selected mode’s outcomes and can explain the limitations. Completion records self-review, not a score or verified assessment.
I preserved originals and retained candidates, compared unrelated package state and completed only the exact cleanup.
coverage: LPIC-1 active v5.0 partial 102.5 102.5 RPM removal. DNF4 awareness, not original YUM, DNF5 or Zypper proficiency. No complete-objective or LPI endorsement claim.
